notes: Server list refreshes daily by default (24 h; the 168 h option is still available). The emergency source now ships enabled and its list is published as Servers.csv at the repository root, with the retired emergency-sources URL migrated on upgrade. Source discovery now stops below the refresh deadline, so a blocked link falls through to the emergency dataset instead of discarding the whole run. Release assets are named VpnM-<version>-<abi>.apk. SoftEther: the foreground slot is taken with a stub notification before the real one, removing the startForegroundService() crash window. Auto Mode: a user stop can no longer be undone by the pending network retry.
